snap_business_day_staggered.summary: In staggered Pennsylvania counties (e.g. Allegheny), SNAP is issued over the first 10 business days based on the last digit of the 7-digit case record number.
notes: Business days exclude weekends and U.S. federal holidays.

Many PA counties use a single fixed business day for all digits (e.g. Adams = 5th business day). If your county is single-cycle, confirm with your county assistance office — this tool implements the staggered digit→nth-business-day pattern documented for counties such as Allegheny.
Digit 1 → 1st business day … digit 9 → 9th; digit 0 → 10th business day.
